question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Feeble
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Strong)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Feeble"** refers to something that is weak, lacking in physical strength, or faint. (कमज़ोर, दुर्बल)

 
 
• **Example:** The old man's feeble voice was barely audible in the noisy room.
 
 
 
• The word **"Strong"** is the opposite of "Feeble" and refers to something that has great physical power, strength, or durability. (मज़बूत)
 
 
• **Example:** She is a strong athlete who trains every day to maintain her fitness.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that the antonym of **"Feeble"** is **"Strong"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (Strong)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Rare** (दुर्लभ): Something that occurs infrequently or is uncommon.

 
 
• **Example:** This species of bird is so rare that it is seldom seen in the wild.
 
 
 
• **Delicate** (नाज़ुक): Easily broken or damaged; fragile.
 
 
• **Example:** Handle the delicate glassware with care to avoid breaking it.
 
 
 
• **Sickly** (बीमार): Often ill or in poor health.
 
 
• **Example:** The sickly child was given extra care and attention by the nurses.
